added_failures_note: Derived with reckon.crew.review.added_failures_from_gate_logs over the reviewed run's own arms: suite-base-arm.log (revision 6b7c8a2bf2b4, scratch tree, 58 passed, EXIT=0) and suite-after-arm.log (revision db04a33ee1, 58 passed, EXIT=0) report no failing id at either arm, so the head adds no failing test and the count is a measured 0 rather than an unmeasured one. The same helper over negative-control-base-all_debug.log (1 failed, EXIT=1) and gate-all_debug.log (18 passed, EXIT=0): also answers 0.

findings.text: The delivered manifest's baseline_suite (line 30) and after_suite (line 31) are not flat suite records: baseline_suite carries bare keys with the object never closed and after_suite is a placeholder, while negative_control_log at line 28 names docs/evidence/fragments/work-flows-to-the-lane/s79.html, a worktree HTML fragment rather than a log under the run directory. Running reports.audit_manifest over that text with suite_armed=True answers ok=false with five findings, so the two suite arms the run actually measured (58 passed at each arm, in suite-base-arm.log and suite-after-arm.log) are not recorded where promotion reads them and the node's promotion is refused until the record is repaired.

The launches_by_key guard that 88635dbfdd added so a spent grant is not read as the lane's reading has no test that reddens without it: all three tests in tests/test_a_full_reading_does_not_hold_queued_work.py hand the lane a grant of REQUESTS=12 slots for 12 requests, so the allowance never reaches zero after a launch and deleting the guard at this line leaves every added assertion green, which is how the second helping of the same slots would return unnoticed.

The wait's loop takes a full LANE_ROOM_POLL_SECONDS pause even when the pass deadline is nearer than a second, and the max(1, ...) at selection.py:750 guarantees at least one poll, so a pass with 0.2 s of budget left sleeps 1.0 s and overshoots the deadline the wait is documented to respect. The one test that measures the bound asserts elapsed < 10.0 on a 2 s budget, which a one second overshoot survives.
